title: Pope Leo XIV Recovering Well Following Lung Cancer Surgery
subtitle: Doctors report the 71-year-old leader is making good progress after a successful operation to remove a cancerous growth.

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV is currently recovering in a Rome hospital after surgery to remove a cancerous mass from his right lung. Doctors have confirmed that his recovery is following the expected plan. The 71-year-old leader was diagnosed with adenocarcinoma, which is the most common form of lung cancer. World leaders have sent messages of support and well wishes to the pontiff. Despite the health scare, medical experts suggest he may be able to resume his busy travel schedule soon.
summary.zh: 教宗利奧十四世目前正在羅馬的一家醫院休養，先前他接受了手術，切除右肺的癌性腫瘤。醫師已證實他的復原進度符合預期。這位七十一歲的領袖被診斷出罹患肺腺癌，這是最常見的肺癌類型。各國領袖已紛紛致意並表達祝福。儘管這次健康狀況令人擔憂，但醫學專家認為，考量到他的復原狀況，他或許很快就能恢復繁忙的訪問行程。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV is making a steady recovery following a successful operation to remove a cancerous growth from his right lung. The 71-year-old leader, who was elected as the head of the Roman Catholic Church in May 2025, underwent the 90-minute procedure at Rome’s Gemelli hospital late on Tuesday. According to The Guardian, the Vatican has confirmed that the pontiff is already walking in his hospital room and eating normally.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗利奧十四世（Pope Leo XIV）在成功切除右肺腫瘤手術後，目前復原狀況穩定。這位七十一歲的領袖於二零二五年五月當選為羅馬天主教會的最高領導人，他於週二深夜在羅馬的傑梅利醫院（Gemelli hospital）接受了長達九十分鐘的手術。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，梵蒂岡已證實教宗目前已能在病房內走動，且飲食正常。

paragraphs.en: Doctors Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritoria, who are overseeing his care, released a statement noting that the pope’s post-operative progress is within the expected range. They based this assessment on recent blood tests and chest X-rays. The surgery confirmed that the pope has adenocarcinoma, which is the most common type of lung cancer. While this diagnosis came as a surprise to many, the Vatican had previously announced that doctors found a small, "well-contained" nodule during a routine checkup, allowing for early detection.
paragraphs.zh: 負責照護教宗的醫師路易吉·卡博內（Luigi Carbone）與斯特凡諾·馬加里托里亞（Stefano Margaritoria）發表聲明指出，教宗術後的恢復進度符合預期。這項評估是基於近期的血液檢查與胸部Ｘ光結果。手術證實教宗罹患的是肺腺癌，這是最常見的肺癌類型。儘管這項診斷讓許多人感到意外，但梵蒂岡先前曾宣布，醫師在例行檢查中發現了一個小型且「控制良好」的結節，因此得以早期發現。

paragraphs.en: Medical experts have provided insights into what this diagnosis means for the pope’s future. Dr. Otis Brawley, an oncologist at Johns Hopkins University, explained to NPR that adenocarcinoma is frequently found in non-smokers. He noted that because the lesion was small and surgically removed, the pope may not require further aggressive treatments like chemotherapy or radiation, provided that follow-up tests on his lymph nodes remain negative. Dr. Brawley added that the pope’s active lifestyle—including playing tennis—likely helped him tolerate the surgery well. He suggested that patients in good physical shape often return to their normal routines within seven to ten days.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學專家針對這項診斷對教宗未來的影響提供了見解。約翰霍普金斯大學（Johns Hopkins University）的腫瘤學家奧蒂斯·布勞利（Otis Brawley）醫師向美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）解釋，肺腺癌常發生於非吸菸者身上。他指出，由於病灶較小且已透過手術切除，只要後續的淋巴結檢查結果呈陰性，教宗或許不需要接受化學治療或放射治療等進一步的積極治療。布勞利醫師補充說，教宗平時活躍的生活方式（包括打網球）可能有助於他順利承受手術。他認為，身體狀況良好的患者通常在七到十天內就能恢復正常作息。

paragraphs.en: News of the pope’s condition has prompted an outpouring of support from around the globe. According to The Guardian, Britain’s King Charles, who is also receiving treatment for an undisclosed form of cancer, sent private well wishes to the pontiff. Other leaders, including US President Donald Trump, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, have publicly expressed their hopes for a quick and full recovery. These leaders praised the pope as a source of inspiration and strength for millions of people.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗的病情消息引發了全球各地的支持與慰問。根據《衛報》報導，同樣正在接受某種未公開癌症治療的英國國王查爾斯（King Charles）已私下向教宗表達祝福。其他領袖，包括美國總統川普（Donald Trump）、加拿大總理馬克·卡尼（Mark Carney）以及歐盟執委會主席馮德萊恩（Ursula von der Leyen），皆公開表達希望他能早日完全康復。這些領袖讚揚教宗是數百萬人心中的靈感與力量來源。

paragraphs.en: Before the surgery, the Vatican cancelled all of the pope’s official appointments until October 20. However, there is already discussion regarding his future travel plans. The pope is scheduled to visit South America in November for a 12-day trip that includes stops in ten different cities. While such a trip sounds demanding, Dr. Brawley told NPR that he believes the pope could be fit enough to travel, given the nature of the surgery and the expected recovery time.
paragraphs.zh: 手術前，梵蒂岡取消了教宗直到十月二十日的所有官方行程。然而，目前已有關於他未來出訪計畫的討論。教宗原定於十一月前往南美洲進行為期十二天的訪問，行程包含十個不同城市。雖然這趟旅程聽起來相當吃力，但布勞利醫師告訴美國國家公共廣播電台，考量到手術性質與預期的恢復時間，他認為教宗的身體狀況應足以應付旅行。

paragraphs.en: As the world watches his progress, the Vatican has maintained a level of transparency that is considered rare. The pope himself first shared news of the nodule during his Sunday prayer, explaining that it had been caught early. This openness has been welcomed by many as a sign of honesty during a difficult time. While the Vatican has not yet shared the results of all follow-up tests to determine if the cancer has spread, the current focus remains on his successful recovery in Rome.
paragraphs.zh: 在全世界關注教宗復原進度的同時，梵蒂岡保持了罕見的透明度。教宗本人在週日祈禱時首次分享了結節的消息，並解釋這是早期發現的。這種公開態度被許多人視為在艱難時刻展現誠實的象徵。雖然梵蒂岡尚未公布所有後續檢查結果以確認癌症是否擴散，但目前的焦點仍放在他在羅馬的順利康復上。

paragraphs.en: For now, the pontiff is expected to remain in the hospital for about a week. As BBC News reports, people have been gathering in St. Peter’s Square to offer their prayers and support. The focus remains on his continued health as he moves through the next stages of his recovery. With his doctors expressing satisfaction with his progress, the global community continues to wait for further updates on when he might return to his full duties as the leader of the church.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，預計教宗將在醫院停留約一週。正如英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）報導，民眾紛紛聚集在聖伯多祿廣場（St. Peter’s Square）為他祈禱並表達支持。隨著他進入復原的下一階段，大眾持續關注他的健康狀況。醫師們對他的進度表示滿意，國際社會也持續等待關於他何時能重返教會領袖職務的進一步消息。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Healthy, strong, and physically capable of doing something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（適合、安裝），這裡作形容詞，指身體狀況足以應付某事。文中：Dr. Brawley told NPR that he believes the pope could be fit enough to travel, given the nature of the surgery and the expected recovery time.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A sudden, strong expression of emotion or support from many people.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞 pour（倒）構成的名詞，指大量湧出的支持。文中：News of the pope’s condition has prompted an outpouring of support from around the globe.

quiz.question: What specific factor did doctors use to determine that the pope's recovery is progressing as expected?

options.A: His ability to walk around the hospital room immediately after surgery.
options.B: The results of recent blood tests and chest X-rays.
options.C: His history of physical fitness and playing tennis.
options.D: The successful removal of the cancerous growth during the 90-minute operation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，醫生 Luigi Carbone 和 Stefano Margaritoria 明確指出，他們對教宗術後恢復進度的評估是基於「recent blood tests and chest X-rays」。選項 A 雖然提到他能走路，但那是恢復後的現象而非評估標準；選項 C 是醫生提到他耐受手術的原因，而非術後進度指標；選項 D 是手術成功的描述，與術後監測無關。

quiz.question: Based on the article, what can be inferred about the pope's potential travel plans for November?

options.A: He will definitely cancel the trip because it is too demanding after lung surgery.
options.B: The Vatican has already officially confirmed that the trip will proceed as scheduled.
options.C: It is medically plausible for him to go, provided his recovery continues at the current pace.
options.D: He must undergo chemotherapy before he can be considered fit enough to travel.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第五段提到，儘管行程聽起來很吃力，但醫生 Dr. Brawley 表示，考慮到手術性質與預期恢復時間，教宗可能有足夠的體力出訪。選項 A 過於武斷，文章並未說一定會取消；選項 B 錯誤，文章僅說有討論，未確認行程；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到若後續檢查結果良好，他可能不需要進行化療等積極治療。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the word 'tolerate' mean in the context of the pope's surgery?

options.A: To endure or handle a difficult physical experience without severe negative consequences.
options.B: To permit or allow something to happen despite personal disapproval.
options.C: To wait patiently for a long period of time for a recovery to occur.
options.D: To show kindness and mercy toward those who performed the surgery.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，tolerate 指的是身體對於手術這種重大醫療介入的承受能力。選項 B 是「容忍」的常見用法，但在醫療語境下不適用；選項 C 與「等待」有關，與承受手術無關；選項 D 是「寬容」的意思，完全偏離了醫學描述健康狀況的語義。
